posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md: My wife ordered me to clean up my lab. I found an ammo box with some plates in it that I didn't know I had. They are wrapped with the red on outside and black inside paper, so they are probably Slavich. What would you do? Expose a part with red and another with green? I have no idea when I bought them or how old they are.

posts.author: shawnoram16
posts.content_md:
As you say in your details it is so thoughtful thing. you have to give it back to in-charge of lab. One of the biggest mysteries for Disney License Plates is colored backs. Numerous plates have been found with different colored backs. While the reason for the variation is not known, there are several possible explanations.

Several license plates have been found with and without the ID number printed on the plate.
